svg.aria-label: one repository, two runtimes: srt/'s LLM runtime and multimodal_gen/'s diffusion runtime each have their own scheduling, caching and model layers, sharing the kernels, the distributed layer, the platform layer and the interface style

text.tspan: the unit: a token, looping until it ends
continuous batching by a token budget
a KV cache plus the radix prefix cache
TP / EP / DP attention / PD / speculative decoding
dllm/: diffusion-style text generation on this runtime
the unit: one image or video, a fixed number of steps
batched by image; latents of a fixed size, no KV
feature caching (across steps), condition caching (across requests)
sequence parallelism, guidance parallelism, a pipeline by stage

svg.text: shared: sgl-kernel, distributed/, platforms/ and hardware_backend/, the CUDA graph approach, the OpenAI-style interface, launch_server and the CLI
why start separately: the two workloads differ in the unit of generation, the batching, the state, the cache reuse and the parallelism
CI triggered by directory (#12940); both sides are connecting Rust's multimodal preprocessing (rust/sglang-mm)
